ecosystem.notes: Bookings is a non-GAAP measure (sales of Robux and subscriptions, before deferral). Roblox records revenue gross, as principal, so Revenue includes the money later paid to developers; developer exchange fees are an expense line, recognised 'as earned Robux are accumulated by creators that are qualified and registered in the Developer Exchange Program'. Revenue / Bookings therefore overstates what Roblox keeps. Developer exchange fees are the expense recognised in 2025, not necessarily cash paid in 2025.
ecosystem.ratioNote: Roblox records revenue gross, so revenue already includes amounts later paid to developers; the share would understate what creators receive.
